texts.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
texts.en:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

label.zh: 将消息传达给所有舰队指挥官。
必须近距离研究这些生物。
label.en: These creatures must be studied closer.

label.zh: 真的无法与他们进行理论吗？
label.en: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?
This will cut into our profit margins...

label.zh: 可恶的外星生物，一定要把它们统统干掉。
label.en: These wretched xenos will be purged.

label.zh: 真有意思……来自高维的生命体。
这对任何有感知的生物来说都是个威胁。
label.en: This is a threat to all sapient life.

label.zh: 真是令人着迷……系外的生命体。
label.en: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们的星系之中出现了巨大的空间织构裂痕，可作为连接其它次元的单向通道。奇怪的虚体飞船从中涌出，他们会从路上碰到的一切物体身上吸取能源，直到那不幸的物体失去一切能源为止。
texts.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space has appeared in our galaxy, acting as some sort of one-way conduit between our reality and another. Strange ethereal spacecraft are pouring in through this dimensional portal, and they seem to leech energy to lethal effect from those unfortunate enough to be caught in their path.

texts.zh: ……到达觅食区域……猎物很多……终于……可以大吃一顿……
texts.en: ...feeding ground reached... prey bountiful... at long last... we shall feast...

texts.zh: 我们失去了[Root.GetName]殖民地！这些来自异次元的侵略者先是摧毁了轨道空间站，而后对着星球表面狂轰滥炸，收割了地表上的所有生命。[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的整个生物圈都被毁灭殆尽——连一点生命的痕迹都没有了。
texts.en: We have lost our colony on [Root.GetName]! After taking up positions in orbit, the extradimensional invaders bombarded the surface and feasted on all life forms below. The [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire biosphere was consumed by the creatures - not a single trace of anything living remains.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价阻止那些怪物！

texts.zh:
当最后一个维度传送门被摧毁后留下的能量旋涡最终消散时，我们的部队发现附近有一个虚弱的异次元体在飘荡。我们捕获了这个生物并进行了审讯。

这显然是它们的一个“术士”，即便是以它们的标准来评判，它也是一位强大的异次元体。它负责维持我们和他们的现实之间的传送门。如果我们能够研究或者引用它的灵能，我们应该能够极大的提高我们的亚光速航速和跃迁引擎的跃迁范围。
texts.en:
When the swirling energies left behind after the destruction of the last dimensional portal finally dissipated, our forces found a weakened extradimensional drifting nearby. The creature was captured and interrogated.

It is apparently one of their "Warlocks" - a powerful extradimensional even by their standards, responsible for maintaining the portal's link between our reality and theirs. If we can study or even channel its psionic power, we should be able to greatly improve our sublight speeds and jump drive range.

texts.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
texts.en:
The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.

With the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

texts.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。

The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

label.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

texts.zh:
异次元入侵者最初的入侵点已经被摧毁了。

但是，我们现在还不能松懈，一定要确保所有的传送门都被摧毁。只有摧毁所有传送门，才能彻底切断两个次元之间的联系。
texts.en:
The initial breaching point that was used by the extradimensionals to invade our galaxy has been destroyed.

We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our dimension and theirs be permanently severed.
...prey...

texts.zh: ……屈膝于……我们的荣耀吧……
texts.en: ...behold... our glory...
...nourishment...

texts.zh: ……这一存在……见识过虚境……
texts.en: ...this one... has seen into the Shroud...

texts.zh: ……它被虚境……触碰过……
texts.en: ...it has been touched... by the Shroud...

texts.zh: ……这一存在……据有着能力……它可以看见……
texts.en: ...there is... power... in this one... it can SEE...

texts.zh: ……合成体……
texts.en: ...synthetic beings...

label.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
label.en: Can there be peace between us?

label.zh: 你们会后悔来到这个次元的。
label.en: You picked the wrong dimension to invade.

responses.zh: ……不……这个次元……很美好……猎物很多……
responses.en: ...no... this dimension... is glorious... so much prey...

label.zh: 你们这些外星物种真是恶心。
label.en: You are just another type of wretched xeno.

responses.en: ...so much hatred... so much fear... it is... wonderful...

label.zh: 介绍一下你们。让我们互相了解一下吧。
label.en: Tell us about yourselves. Help us understand you.

label.zh: 你们来自某个存在的更高位面吗？
label.en: Do you come from a higher plane of existence?

responses.zh: ……虚境……我们听说过……离我们的家园很近……很近……
responses.en: ...the Shroud... we know of it... it is close to where we come from... very close...

texts.zh: ……能讲话？
texts.en: ...it speaks?

texts.zh: ……这些颜色真美……
texts.en: ...look at all the pretty colors...

texts.zh: ……一定要……汲取……
texts.en: ...must... feed...

texts.zh: ……沙达衮……你怎么在这……
texts.en: ...shadagon... why are you here...

texts.zh: ……王座……一定要保住……王座……
texts.en: ...the throne... must preserve... the throne...

texts.zh: ……必须……觅食……
texts.en: ...must... consume...

texts.zh: ……去死吧……
从第二个虫洞中出来的飞船和之前的非常相似，但仍然有几处细微的不同。据报告称，这些新来的飞船竟和之前的入侵者打起来了！我们也从第二个虫洞处截获了强大的信号。
texts.en:
The ships that have been emerging from the second wormhole are very similar to the ones that came from the first, but there are several subtle differences between them. Furthermore, early reports indicate that ships belonging to these new invaders have clashed with those of the first group!

We have intercepted a powerful signal emanating from the second wormhole.

texts.zh: ……沙巴纳什……原来你们逃到了这里……休想躲到这个次元……我们会干掉你们，占据觅食区……
texts.en: ...shabanash... so this is where you ran... this realm will offer you no shelter... we shall deal with you, and then claim this feeding ground for ourselves...

texts.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第二传送门也被摧毁了！高维入侵者已经无法用此传送门呼叫援兵了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
texts.en:
The second dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the extradimensionals to reinforce their numbers.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy.

texts.zh:
出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第二传送门也被摧毁了！高维入侵者已经无法用此传送门呼叫援兵了。

摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
texts.en:
The third dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system is no more. It will no longer be used by the extradimensionals to bridge the gap between their realm and ours.

With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 最后残存的高维入侵者也已被彻底消灭，希望我们这回算是一劳永逸地消除了这些家伙对宇宙的威胁。全宇宙的智能生物都在庆祝这一伟大的胜利，在得知不必再惧怕成为他们盘中之餐的消息后，所有人都松了一口气。也许，这会成为宇宙新一轮全面合作与友谊的开端呢？
texts.en:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as food by these strange energy creatures after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?

texts.zh: 最后残存的高维入侵者也已被彻底消灭，希望我们这回算是一劳永逸地消除了这些家伙对宇宙的威胁。全宇宙的智能生物都在庆祝这一伟大的胜利，在得知不必再惧怕成为他们盘中之餐的消息后，所有人都松了一口气。也许，这会成为宇宙新一轮全面合作与友谊的开端呢？
texts.en:
The last vestiges of the extradimensional invaders have been wiped out, hopefully ridding the galaxy of this threat for good.

Sapients everywhere are celebrating the news of this great victory, safe at last in the knowledge that they won't be harvested as food by these strange energy creatures after all. Perhaps this is the beginning of a new era of galactic cooperation and friendship?

label.zh: 我们的精神又经历了一次严峻的考验。
label.en: Our spiritual armor has weathered yet another storm.

label.zh: 某一天，也许会轮到我们来入侵他们的世界吧。
label.en: One day, perhaps we will be the ones invading their realm.

label.zh: 可惜，并没有机会研究他们的次元。
label.en: Unfortunate that we had no opportunity to study their dimension.

label.zh: 多希望能和他们和平共处啊。
label.en: If only there had been a way to peacefully co-exist with them.

label.zh: 宇宙经济应该很快就会恢复元气的。
label.en: The galactic economy should make a swift recovery.

label.zh: 这些可悲的生物选错了对手。
label.en: Those creatures made a mistake when they invaded our dimension.

label.zh: 可惜他们的侵略性太强。我们本可以互相学习借鉴的。
label.en: They were a fascinating, if dangerous, form of life.

texts.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
texts.en:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.

texts.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
texts.en:
Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.

It looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.

label.en: This has gone from bad to worse.

texts.zh: 出现了第二阵营的异次元入侵者开始出现在我们星系，攻击意愿不逊于之前一波。幸运的是，两支异次元体部队似乎也打起来了。
texts.en: A second faction of extradimensional invaders has appeared in our galaxy, no less hostile than the previous one. Fortunately, the extradimensionals seem to be fighting each other as well.

texts.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
texts.en:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

texts.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
texts.en:
A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?

We are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

texts.zh: 来自另一个虫洞的三号阵营异次元部队出现了。他们也有意吞噬这个星系中的所有生物，但目前已与前两波入侵者陷入了苦战。
texts.en: A third extradimensional faction has emerged from yet another wormhole. Although they are also intent on consuming all life in our galaxy, they seem to be engaged in some kind of three-way war with the other factions from their dimension.

texts.zh: ……沙巴纳什……达伽尔……你们居然躲到了这里……你们逃不掉的……我们会摧毁你俩的过度……然后……最终……永恒的王座将属于我们……
texts.en: ...dagaal... shabanash... you were fools to come to this realm... there is no escape from us... we shall destroy both your kingdoms... then... at last... the eternal throne will be ours...

label.en: Is there no end to them?

texts.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
texts.en:
A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

title.zh: 与星海监管人并肩而战……
title.en: Stand by for the Galactic Custodian...

texts.zh:
星海共同体的可敬成员们……智慧生物同胞们。

星海正格外黑暗。我们面临的生死危机史无前例。为了挺过接下来的猛攻，我们必须如同明天我们将不复存在一般战斗，因为，我们也许真的没有明天了。

在你们选举我们成为星海监管人时，我们宣誓要捍卫星系，拼尽一切来兑现承诺……但这并非一场我们独自能够赢得的战役。我们吁请全体成员国搁置异见，与我们并肩反击[crisis_country.GetName]的进攻！只要齐心协力，我们定能展现星海的完整威力，抵御共同的敌人。
texts.en:
Honorable members of the Galactic Community... fellow sapients.

This is an exceedingly dark time for our galaxy. The existential threat we face is without precedent. To survive the coming onslaught, we must fight like there is no tomorrow, for in truth, that may be the case.

When you elected us as your Galactic Custodians, we swore an oath to defend our galaxy and we will do everything in our power to uphold that promise... but this is not a battle we can win alone. We call on all members to put aside their differences and join us as we strike back at the [crisis_country.GetName]! Together we will show them the full might of our galaxy as it stands united against a common foe!

texts.zh:
星海已四面楚歌！[crisis_country.GetName]盯上了我们的军队，但我们毫无能长时间抵抗的希望！

作为星海的监管人，保护全体共同体成员不受外界的威胁是您应尽的职责，请尽您所能地提供援助吧！
texts.en:
The galaxy is under attack! Our forces have engaged the [crisis_country.GetName], but we have little hope of holding them off for long!

As the Galactic Custodians, it is your duty to defend all Community members from external threats! Please, send all the help you can!

title.en: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...

texts.zh:
帝国的公民们。我们一起经历了很多的苦难，但是今日帝国面临空前绝后的严峻挑战。我们的星系正被[crisis_country.GetName]威胁——他们与其他敌人不一样——若放任不管，他们将终结我们所知的一切智慧生命。

但是我们的前途并非绝望！星海帝国正在全力进行总动员以驱赶这些入侵者。我们的国家不再在腐朽的共同体下各自为政，而是在全星系有史以来最伟大的帝国的旗帜下团结一致。

在[From.GetRulerTitle]领导下团结起来吧！大战即将来临，但比以往更加强大的星海帝国终会摆脱困境！荣耀就在前方！
texts.en:
Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.

But do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.

Rally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!

texts.zh:
帝皇陛下，星海正处于前所未有的险境之中。我们的军队正遭受[crisis_country.GetName]的严重威胁。一旦我方被击败，他们一定会吞并帝国的剩余部分！

作为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，保护帝国全体国民是你应尽的职责。我们恳请您即刻出兵！
texts.en:
Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the [crisis_country.GetName] and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!

As the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]中所有仪器突然全数感应到了巨大的亚空间能源波动，其源头就在我们星系之中。我们的科学家也难以解释其中原因——这种奇异现象可是前所未见。源头的具体位置尚不明确，我们仍在继续分析现有数据。
texts.en:
Instruments across the [Root.GetName] have suddenly picked up a subspace power surge of massive proportions coming from somewhere within our galaxy. Our scientists are struggling to come up with an explanation for this event - nothing of its like has ever been recorded.

The exact origin point of this sudden power surge has yet to be identified, but we are still in the process of analyzing the available data.

texts.zh:
我们已经对之前检测到的巨大能源波完成了甄别。它来源于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系中一个巨大的亚空间裂缝。奇怪的飞船从传送门中蜂拥而出，初步报告显示，这些飞船会对接触到的任何事物发动无差别的攻击。

我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的一段高能信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
texts.en:
The source of the massive power surge we detected earlier has been identified. It comes from some kind of gigantic subspace tear in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. Fleets of strange spacecraft are pouring out of this dimensional portal, and early reports speak of indiscriminate attacks against everyone coming into contact with them.

We have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

label.zh: 将消息传达给所有舰队指挥官。
必须近距离研究这些生物。
label.en: These creatures must be studied closer.

label.zh: 真的无法与他们进行理论吗？
label.en: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?
This will cut into our profit margins...

label.zh: 可恶的外星生物，一定要把它们统统干掉。
label.en: These wretched xenos will be purged.

label.zh: 真有意思……来自高维的生命体。
这对任何有感知的生物来说都是个威胁。
label.en: This is a threat to all sapient life.

label.zh: 真是令人着迷……系外的生命体。
label.en: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.
